**STEP 6 - Grams:** Dense, layered item, so bulk density ≈ 0.9 g/ml. 352 ml × 0.9 ≈ 317 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Baked lasagna is roughly 140 kcal per 100 g. 317 g × 1.40 ≈ 444 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A half-covered 20 cm plate with a thick, layered baked dish of about 300 g and roughly 440 kcal is plausible. The estimate covers only the lasagna. Adding the salad, fruit and chicken on the tray would substantially increase the total.
